thread:
harper_csm: Heads-up — RiftStream renewal in 5 weeks. They're happy functionally but cited sharp cost growth and sporadic p95 spikes during peak ingestion windows. Proposing a short canary: 10% -> m-rift-v2:int8 + route low-priority embeddings/batch to m-small-lite. Need eng + SRE sign-off and customer OK.

jules_cs: They'll ask for estimated savings and exact rollback timing. Can we quantify and offer an SLA? I'll log in Gainsight.

harper_csm: Recent 48h baseline: p50 145ms, p95 470ms, tails up to 1.15s at concurrency >75. Unit cost ~ $395 / 1M tokens. Ballpark int8 savings ~30-38% compute; median latency +10-25ms but throughput boost reduces queueing so tail may improve.

mina_engineer: I can create an int8 build and run regression on a 180-sample eval set. Recommend 48h canary @10% with automated similarity + error checks and manual spot checks. Regression threshold: pass_rate >= 0.9 and max_metric_delta <= 0.02.

sam_sre: Infra asks to bump min replicas for canary pool to avoid autoscale gaps. Also enable route-level prefix caching for repeated assistant contexts and steer non-critical flows to m-small-lite during the canary. I'll add alert: p95 > 750ms OR error_rate > 0.5% -> immediate rollback.

harper_csm: Draft to RiftStream: "We propose a brief 48h canary (10% traffic) using a quantized variant to evaluate unit cost savings (~30-35%). We'll monitor automated and manual quality checks and rollback within 30 minutes if thresholds exceed limits." Thoughts?

jules_cs: Add explicit rollback SLA and include the savings estimate. I'll request a 150-200 sample eval set from them.

mina_engineer: Canary deploy command I'll run: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy --customer riftstream --model m-rift-v2:int8 --route canary --weight 0.10 --tag rift-canary-2026-03
```

mina_engineer: Quick local eval (180 samples): pass 162/180, avg_similarity 0.980, max_delta 0.014 — mostly small formatting diffs on tables.

sam_sre: I've provisioned min replicas=3 for the canary pool, set routing rules, and added the alert.

deploy-bot: Canary started for riftstream (canary id: rf-canary-7c3). Weight: 10%. Region: us-west-2.

harper_csm: Action items: mina -> full regression + attach diffs to ticket RF-4021 (ETA 8h). sam -> confirm infra/alerts monitoring (ETA 2h). jules -> Gainsight entry + customer outreach (ETA 4h). Reconvene 24h after rollout start.

jules_cs: I'll note expected savings in renewal playbook and pull sample diffs for the customer.

mina_engineer: If tail latency persists, plan B: route mid-priority chat to m-chat-small and enable KV prefix caching for repeated conversation contexts.

harper_csm: Thanks all. Will send the message to RiftStream once we have the eval set. :thumbsup:
